description: This PHP source file defines and initializes a set of custom views (filters and columns) for various modules in a vtiger CRM system, including functions to insert these views and their configurations into the database.

methods.name: insertCustomView
methods.description: Inserts a new custom view record into the vtiger_customview table with parameters such as view name, default flag, metrics flag, module name, status, and user ID. Returns the generated custom view ID.

methods.name: insertCvColumns
methods.description: Inserts a list of column configurations associated with a specific custom view ID into the vtiger_cvcolumnlist table.

methods.name: insertCvStdFilter
methods.description: Inserts a standard filter (column, criteria, date range) for a custom view into the vtiger_cvstdfilter table.

methods.name: insertCvAdvFilter
methods.description: Inserts advanced filters into the vtiger_cvadvfilter table for a specific custom view ID, including logic to group filters with a grouping condition.
